classification.difficultyReason: Use linked row, column and diagonal constraints to complete fractional magic squares.

content.prompt: Complete each of the following magic squares. Each row, column and diagonal sums to the same mixed number.

answer.worked:
The bottom row gives the common sum: $\frac{1}{3}+\frac{1}{4}+\frac{2}{3}=1\frac{1}{4}=\frac{15}{12}$.

Top right: $\frac{15}{12}-\frac{1}{12}-\frac{2}{3}=\frac{1}{2}$.

Centre: $\frac{15}{12}-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{3}=\frac{5}{12}$.

Middle left: $\frac{15}{12}-\frac{5}{12}-\frac{1}{12}=\frac{3}{4}$.

Top left: $\frac{15}{12}-\frac{3}{4}-\frac{1}{3}=\frac{1}{6}$.

Top middle: $\frac{15}{12}-\frac{5}{12}-\frac{1}{4}=\frac{7}{12}$.

Every row, column and diagonal sums to $1\frac{1}{4}$.

The middle row gives the common sum: $\frac{1}{4}+1\frac{1}{4}+2\frac{1}{4}=3\frac{3}{4}$.

Bottom left: $3\frac{3}{4}-2-\frac{1}{4}=1\frac{1}{2}$.

Bottom right: $3\frac{3}{4}-2-1\frac{1}{4}=\frac{1}{2}$.

Top right: $3\frac{3}{4}-2\frac{1}{4}-\frac{1}{2}=1$.

Top middle: $3\frac{3}{4}-2-1=\frac{3}{4}$.

Bottom middle: $3\frac{3}{4}-\frac{3}{4}-1\frac{1}{4}=1\frac{3}{4}$.

Every row, column and diagonal sums to $3\frac{3}{4}$.
